profile.headline: Software Engineer at Root16
profile.summary:
👋 Hi, I'm Amie.

I always had a curiosity for coding and began teaching myself online as a fun hobby when I quickly realized I wanted to pursue it as a career. I found my passion for coding in the combination of math/science and creativity.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · C# · Microsoft Dynamics · Microsoft Dynamics CRM · Microsoft Dynamics 365 · Microsoft Power Automate

positions.title: Software Engineering Technical Coach
positions.description:
• Coach students through Flatiron School’s Software Engineering curriculum consisting of Javascript, React.js, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, and Flask. 
• Exemplify the developer’s mindset by guiding stuck students through labs efficiently, effectively, and with kindness using the socratic method.
• Review lines of code/error messages to teach students how to effectively debug.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Bootstrap · Git · React.js · JavaScript · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · SQL · REST APIs

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Howl is a creator platform for the customer centric and product obsessed. Creators of every size use Howl’s commerce and payments technology to get better rates and easy payments for their big ideas. Creators on Howl earn more when they open doors for others, and have the tools to turn their craft into a business.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Web Development · Git · React.js · JavaScript · SQL · Jira · REST APIs

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Narrativ is a subscription technology platform for brands to acquire new customers through trust-based marketing. We built an ad-free alternative to the e-commerce growth marketing playbook by building the commerce and payments infrastructure for the creator economy.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Web Development · Git · React.js · JavaScript · SQL · Jira · REST APIs
